title: Ripcord
description: Spin your phone and the top spins with it. The gyroscope reads your peak angular speed during the rip -- degrees per second, live on a gauge -- and that number becomes your launch RPM, directly proportional. Then drop into a bowl stadium against rival tops across four difficulty tiers: attack, defense and stamina beat each other in a circle, clashes throw sparks and lightning, and the last top spinning wins. Throw it and freefall is detected too, though a hard wrist flick reads exactly the same.
